answer: We formulate a cryptoeconomic mechanism where agents stake dynamic opportunity-cost bonds locked via zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, securing block nectar inside an opal commitment scheme. Upon adversarial identity multiplication across multiple Sybil nodes, a subgame-perfect punishment matrix triggers severe collateral slashing, ensuring that net expected attack utility remains strictly negative. Consequently, within this structured lotus topology, honest consensus participation converges to a robust Nash equilibrium.
